about: Spec 3.9.0 (interactive.md): interactive-only models. `models`: the served models in the list's order, each `{id, interactive_only?}` (absent: false). `kind: twin` — `model` → the id of the same model on a connection that is not interactive-only (another id with the same part after its first `/`, the first in order), or null. `kind: background` — where a background call that would use `model` goes. `call`: `title`, `compaction` (the person asked) or `auto_compaction`; `defaults`: the defaults to try after the twin, in order (a device: its global `model` setting, then the instance's default; the server: the instance's default) — one that is not listed or is interactive-only is passed over. `unfit`: models that cannot take the call (for a summary: a context window below what must be sent, or no tools for a conversation with tool calls) — passed over like models that are not listed. → `{model}` (the model asked: itself, the twin or a default), `{skip: true}`, or `{refused}` with loop.json interactive.texts.compact. `kind: scheduled` — scheduled work on `model` (a run's session, its subagent, a one-shot run with nobody at it): → `{run: true}`, or `{refused}` with interactive.texts.scheduled, `{{model}}` the id. The server's twin also has to be one the person may use in the chat's data group, which no case here turns on. CLI: src/provider/interactive.ts; LLeMbas: services/interactive.py.

cases.about: The plan's pay-as-you-go twin: the same model under another provider.
A twin that is itself interactive-only is none.
The part after the first slash is compared whole: a longer name is another model.
The first in the list's order.
A model that is not interactive-only is asked itself, as before.
A title for a session on a plan's model goes to the twin.
No twin: the default that is not interactive-only.
The first default is interactive-only too, the second is not.
A default the list does not have is passed over.
Nowhere to go: a title is skipped.
Nowhere to go: compaction the person asked for is refused in words.

expect.refused: This chat's model is on a connection for interactive use only, and compacting is background work its provider's terms do not allow. It needs the same model on a pay-as-you-go connection, or a default model that is not interactive-only.

cases.about: Nowhere to go: automatic compaction is skipped and the turn goes on.
